ai/core/AttackManager: Decides when and where to attack: intervals, minimum sizes, KOTH/titan state and attack history.
ai/core/AttackManager.calculateMinAttack: Sets the minimum attack army size from difficulty and personality.
ai/core/AttackManager.updateState: Updates attack state flags (King of the Hill, titans, Ragnarok, cease-fire) used to decide attacks.
ai/core/AttackManager.waitedLongEnough: True if the attack interval has passed since the last attack.

ai/core/AttackWave.addAttackUnitType: Adds a unit type the wave may use.

ai/core/AttackWave.displayFirstAttackSta: Debug output about the first attack timing (empty in shipped code).

ai/core/AttackWave.removeAttackUnitType: Removes a unit type from the wave.
ai/core/AttackWave.setAttackInterval: Sets the seconds between waves, keeping the next launch time consistent.
ai/core/AttackWave.setAttackRouteID: Sets an attack route ID for the wave.
ai/core/AttackWave.setAttackSize: Sets the wave size (and minimum size).
ai/core/AttackWave.setAttackSizeMultipli: Sets the factor applied to the wave size after each wave.
ai/core/AttackWave.setAttackStartTime: Sets when the first wave launches (seconds offset from now).
ai/core/AttackWave.setGatherPoint: Sets where wave units gather before attacking.
ai/core/AttackWave.setPlayerToAttack: Sets the player the wave attacks.
ai/core/AttackWave.setTargetPoint: Sets the point the wave attacks.
ai/core/AttackWave.setWaveStartCallback: Sets a callback run with the attack plan ID when a wave starts.

ai/core/AttackWave.updateExplorePlansNav: Periodically creates or updates scout plans that look for naval targets.
ai/core/BOStep: One build order step: type, parameters, callbacks and completion handler.
ai/core/BOSystem: Build order runtime state: steps, current step, villagers, gather plans, timeouts and main/second base info.
ai/core/BaseDockInfo: Per-base water analysis for docks: shoreline, water area, fish location and defend point.
ai/core/BaseDockInfo.displayInfo: Debug hook to print dock info (empty).
ai/core/BaseDockInfo.doAnalysis: Analyzes a base's nearby water: fish, shoreline and valid dock areas.

ai/core/DockManager.calculateValidWaterI: Computes valid water area IDs for docks along a shoreline.
ai/core/DockManager.findBestBaseToDock: Chooses the best base for docks/fishing (closest, fish available).

ai/core/DockManager.scoutDockShoreline: Explores unexplored shoreline areas near the dock base.

ai/core/MigrationStrategyData: State of the island migration strategy (target mainland area group, in progress).
ai/core/NavalAttackManager: Decides naval attacks: scouting state, intervals and last attack time.
ai/core/NavalAttackManager.updateState: Updates naval attack state (needs scouting, can attack, must hold back).
ai/core/NavalAttackManager.waitedLongEno: True if the naval attack interval has passed.

ai/core/OracleInformation.createReserveP: Creates the reserve plan that holds Oracles for scripted line-of-sight placement.
ai/core/OracleInformation.findClosestTCP: Returns the position of the own town center closest to a point.

ai/core/ResourceBreakdownSystem.applyRes: Enables/disables gathering of food, wood, gold and favor across all gather bases.

Sorts bases (e.g. by distance from the main base) for gathering order.
ai/core/ResourceBreakdownSystem.nullPerc: Sets a base's resource breakdown percentage for a type/subtype to zero.
Zeroes a resource breakdown for all gather bases from an index on.
ai/core/ResourceBreakdownSystem.resource: Distributes food gatherers over existing food sources per base; returns gatherers still needing a plan.
Assigns favor gatherers (e.g. Greek temples, Norse fighting); returns unassigned carry-over.

Re-ranks gather plan priorities from the current resource percentages.
Assigns gold gatherers across bases; returns unassigned carry-over.
Assigns wood gatherers across bases; returns unassigned carry-over.

ai/core/ResourceBreakdownSystem.setMaxFa: Sets the maximum number of farms per base.
Sets how many farms may be added per update.
ai/core/Strategy: A strategy with ID, age, init/update/score lambdas and its StrategyData.
ai/core/Strategy.displayStrategyInformat: Debug output for a strategy (empty in shipped code).
ai/core/StrategyData: Per-strategy settings: flags, maintained train plans, tower and wall amounts.
ai/core/StrategyData.addUnitToMaintain: Adds (or updates) a train plan maintaining a unit count; returns the plan ID.
ai/core/StrategyData.adjustUnitToMaintai: Changes the maintain count and priority of a unit's train plan.
ai/core/StrategyData.removeUnitToMaintai: Destroys the train plan maintaining a unit type.
ai/core/StrategyData.setFlag: Sets or clears a strategy flag bit.
ai/core/StrategyData.setTrainDelay: Sets the delay between trainings for a unit's train plan (minimum 1).
ai/core/StrategyData.setTrainPlanGatherP: Sets the gather point for a unit's train plan.
ai/core/StrategyManager: Holds registered strategies and switches between them as the game progresses.
ai/core/StrategyManager.getStrategyByID: Finds a strategy by ID (by reference); returns its index or -1.
ai/core/StrategyManager.helperAfterStart: Runs age rule groups immediately after switching strategies.

ai/core/StrategyManager.start: Starts strategy management and enables the strategy monitor rule.
ai/core/StrategyManager.startInterruptSt: Temporarily switches to an interrupt strategy by ID.
ai/core/StrategyManager.update: Runs the active strategy's update and switches to a new one when needed.
ai/core/StrategyManager.updateCurrentStr: Stores changes to the active strategy.
ai/core/TradeInformation: Tracks trade route setup: candidate town centers, paths, banned paths, market and trade plan state.
ai/core/TradeInformation.addBannedPathID: Temporarily bans a trade path (records the time).
ai/core/TradeInformation.clearArrays: Clears tracked town centers and destroys calculated trade paths.
ai/core/TradeInformation.marketCompleted: Starts trading once a market exists: sets the trade plan's market/target and caravan training building.
ai/core/TradeInformation.removeBannedPat: Lifts the ban on a trade path.
ai/core/TradeInformation.resetProgressDa: Resets trade setup progress (state, chosen town center, path, market, build plan).
ai/core/TradeInformation.resetTradingDat: Clears the trade plan's market/target and the caravan train building.
ai/core/abandonBaseWeAreDefending: Ends a base defend plan and returns its units to the primary defend plan.

ai/core/addPriestsToEmpowerWith: Adds Egyptian Priests (beyond Archaic) to the list of units available for empowering.
ai/core/addSafeBackAreasToBuildingPlacem: Adds areas behind a base as preferred placement for a building; true if any were added.
ai/core/adjustNavalMaintainPlans: Sets maintain counts for archer, close-combat and siege warship plans.
ai/core/ageUpEventHandler: Handler for any player reaching a new age (not Wonder age); updates plans and strategy for own age-ups.
ai/core/ageUpPlanHandler: Handler for the age-up research plan; clears it when done and retries on failure.
ai/core/alertFoundFoodResources: Resets the failed food search counter.
ai/core/alertFoundGoldResources: Resets the failed gold search counter.

ai/core/areAtMaxConcurrentResearchPlans: True if the AI already runs its maximum number of research plans (unless resources are plentiful).
ai/core/areWeAlreadyAttackingPlayer: True if a top-level land or naval attack plan already targets the player.
ai/core/areWeOrOthersAlreadyDefendingThi: True if we or another ally already defend an allied base.
ai/core/arraySortInt: Insertion-sorts a range of an int array in place with an optional comparator.

ai/core/assignAllTitansToExplorePlans: Gives each titan its own explore plan (recreating plans when needed).
ai/core/assignMikoToBuildPlan: Plan callback: assigns an idle Miko to a build plan.
ai/core/assignOxCartToFood: Callback: assigns a new ox cart to food gathering.
ai/core/assignOxCartToGatherPlan: During the build order, assigns a built ox cart to the gather plan of a resource.
ai/core/assignOxCartToGold: Callback: assigns a new ox cart to gold gathering.
ai/core/assignOxCartToWood: Callback: assigns a new ox cart to wood gathering.

ai/core/aztecHumanUnitPicker: Aztec human unit picker setup (siege handled elsewhere, age-based exclusions); returns counter mode.
ai/core/azteceHumanArcherUnitPicker: Aztec ranged unit picker setup; returns counter mode.

ai/core/boEgyptianPtahClassical: Queues Egyptian build order steps to advance to Classical with Ptah.

ai/core/buildingGetNumberAliveAndPlanned: Counts existing buildings of a type plus those in build plans (optionally per area group).
ai/core/calculateAlliedBaseToDefend: Finds an allied base under threat worth defending; enemy power and base ID by reference.

ai/core/calculateDefaultNumberBuilders: Returns a default builder count for a building and builder type by culture (Kuafu count by reference).

ai/core/calculateMilitaryBuildingplaceme: Sets placement for military buildings, randomly forward or back in the base (fortresses always forward).
ai/core/calculateNavalMilitaryPop: Computes the naval military population to aim for given enemy navy and difficulty (by reference).

ai/core/calculateNumPossibleTowersToBuil: Returns how many more towers can be built (counting Chinese workshop towers).

ai/core/calculateShrinePlacement: Sets Japanese shrine placement near resources, away from the town center and other shrines.
ai/core/calculateTargetBase: Picks an enemy base to attack based on army, titan presence, base types and distance; returns base ID or -1.
ai/core/calculateTowerAmountPerTCBase: Returns how many towers to build per town center base based on personality, difficulty and age.

ai/core/castCreation: Callback: casts the Creation god power at the main base military gather point.
ai/core/checkForTailwind: Sets up a Tailwind cast target when the plan has none yet.
ai/core/checkStrategyFlag: True if a flag bit is set in the current strategy.

ai/core/chineseHumanUnitPicker: Chinese human unit picker setup; returns counter mode.
ai/core/clampVectorToMap: Clamps a position to the map bounds.

ai/core/cleanupGranaries: Deletes or reuses granaries that no longer serve a base or food source.
ai/core/cleanupWoodGoldDropsiteType: Cleans up wood/gold dropsites of a type that are far from active resources.
