ai/core/setDefaultAttackPlanTargetUnitTy: Sets an attack plan to target melee and ranged attackers (and other default types).
ai/core/setDefaultDefendPlanTargetUnitTy: Sets a defend plan to target melee and ranged attackers (and other default types).
ai/core/setDefaultExplorePlanTargetUnitT: Sets an explore plan to target melee and ranged attackers (and other default types).
ai/core/setLastUnderworldInvasionCastTim: Records when Underworld Invasion was last cast.
ai/core/setOverrideStrategy: Sets a lambda that replaces the default strategy initializer.
ai/core/setUpGodPowerPlan: Creates or updates a god power plan for a power with culture-specific casting setup; plan ID by reference.
ai/core/setupAtlanteanGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Atlantean god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupAztecGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Aztec god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupChineseGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Chinese god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupDebugCategories: Creates AI debug output categories and stores their IDs.
ai/core/setupEgyptianGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Egyptian god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupGreekGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Greek god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupJapaneseGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Japanese god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupNavalUnitPicker: Configures a unit picker for warships against a target player.
ai/core/setupNorseGodPowerPlan: Configures casting rules for Norse god powers on a god power plan.
ai/core/setupRavenScoutPlans: Callback: configures explore plans that use ravens.
ai/core/sharedHumanArcherUnitPickerSetup: Resets and configures a unit picker for human ranged units (counter mode, exclusions); returns true if in counter mode.
ai/core/sharedHumanUnitPickerSetup: Resets and configures a unit picker for human melee/cavalry units; returns true if in counter mode.
ai/core/shouldCastRagnarok: True if casting Ragnarok (turning gatherers into heroes) is worthwhile now.
ai/core/shouldRespond: True if a chat taunt code is one the AI responds to.
ai/core/shrineBuildPlanHandler: Handler for Japanese shrine build plans; assigns the building Miko to the finished shrine.
ai/core/siegeMilitaryTraining: Plans culture-specific siege unit training within the available population.
ai/core/spcTCHandler: Handler for the scenario town center build plan; clears it when done or failed.
ai/core/startBOSystem: Starts executing queued build order steps; false if none were queued.
ai/core/taskUnitsToTempleToSacrifice: Sends units in the sacrifice reserve plan to work at the sacrifice temple.
ai/core/tcExpansionBPHandler: Handler for the expansion town center build plan; resets state when done or failed.
ai/core/titanGateRepairStateChangeHandle: Handler for the Titan Gate build/repair plan; marks completion or retries.
ai/core/titanGateStateChangeHandler: Handler for the Titan Gate foundation plan; advances Titan Gate state.
ai/core/townCenterEntry: Town center ID with the areas calculated around it for Oracle placement.
ai/core/tradePlanEventPathingMonitor: Trade plan "can't path" event handler (currently empty).
ai/core/trainNavalMythUnit: Trains an available naval myth unit at the dock when appropriate.
ai/core/transferAllUnitsBetweenTwoPlans: Moves all units (except excluded types) from one plan to another.
ai/core/turnNumberIntoTimeDisplay: Formats seconds as "minutes: M seconds: S".
ai/core/updateBOSystem: Executes the current build order step by type and advances when complete.
ai/core/updateBaseArrays: Updates the list of own town center bases to defend.
ai/core/updateResourceDistribution: Recomputes how villagers are split between food, wood, gold and favor from plan needs, age and strategy.
ai/core/updateTCArrays: Updates tracked town center bases and their per-base data.
ai/core/updateUnitsInKOTHPlan: Sets how many military units the King of the Hill defend plan wants.
ai/core/useSimpleNatureUnitQuery: Configures and returns a shared unit query for Mother Nature units.
ai/core/useSimpleUnitQuery: Configures and returns a shared unit query for a type, player/relation, state and optional position/radius.
ai/core/useUnusedGodPowers: Casts any available god powers in the four slots that have not been used (where supported).
ai/core/villagerTrainedHandlerHelper: Records a newly trained villager in the build order system and requests an update.
ai/core/wantToRebuyGodPower: Decides if a used god power is worth rebuying for its cost given the situation.
ai/core/wonderBuildStateChangeHandler: Handler for the Wonder build plan: enables wonder rules on completion and retries on failure.
ai/human_assist/ResourceBreakdownSystem: Villager assist's gatherer distribution over resource types and bases.
Enables/disables gathering of food, wood, gold and favor across gather bases.
Records the start offsets of a base's resources in each per-type array.
Removes invalid bases and clears cached resource arrays.
Drops the trailing per-base offsets added for a base without resources.
Collects valid resources around a base into per-type arrays; returns how many were found.
Assigns priorities to food subtypes, optionally favoring farms.
Sets a base's resource breakdown percentage for a type/subtype to zero.
Zeroes a resource breakdown for all gather bases from an index on.
Distributes food gatherers over existing food sources per base; returns gatherers still needing a plan.
Assigns food gatherers to hunt, berries, herdables and farms; returns unassigned count.
Re-ranks gather plan priorities from the current resource percentages.
Assigns gold gatherers across bases; returns unassigned carry-over.
Assigns wood gatherers across bases; returns unassigned carry-over.
Rebuilds the list of town center and dropsite gather bases and their resources.
ai/human_assist/buildingGetNumberAliveAn: Counts own buildings of a type plus those in build plans.
ai/human_assist/checkReservePlan: Checks units in the reserve plan (idle/town-bell villagers, fishing ships) and optionally reclaims gatherers; returns a reserve type.
ai/human_assist/createFarmBuildPlan: Creates a farm build plan with placement around a base's town center/dropsites; returns the plan ID.
ai/human_assist/debugBuildings: Debug output hook for buildings (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/debugEconomy: Debug output hook for the economy (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/debugResourceBreakdown: Debug output hook for resource breakdowns (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/debugResourceDistributio: Debug output hook for resource distribution (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/debugUtilities: Debug output hook for utilities (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/debugVPS: Debug output hook for villager assist (empty in shipped code).
ai/human_assist/disableAutoScouting: Stops auto-scouting for a unit (destroys its explore plan).
ai/human_assist/disableFarmPlacement: Stops villager assist from placing farms.
ai/human_assist/disableVillagerAssist: Turns villager assist off: stops distribution, clears resource flags and disables its rules.
ai/human_assist/enableAutoScouting: Starts an explore plan that auto-scouts with a unit (Oracles without looping).
ai/human_assist/enableFarmPlacement: Allows villager assist to place farms.
ai/human_assist/enableVillagerAssist: Turns villager assist on and releases idle reserved villagers back to gathering.
ai/human_assist/getClosestNatureUnitPosi: Returns the position of the closest Mother Nature unit of a type near a position.
ai/human_assist/getClosestUnitByLocation: Returns the closest unit of a type within a radius (optionally same area group); -1 if none.
Returns the closest unit of a type within a radius in the location's area group; -1 if none.
ai/human_assist/getCountOfOwnAliveBuildi: Counts own alive buildings of a type in a base.
ai/human_assist/getFoodNumber: Returns the requested number of food gatherers in the split.
ai/human_assist/getGoldNumber: Returns the requested number of gold gatherers in the split.
ai/human_assist/getIdleUnit: Returns a unit of a type that is not in any plan; -1 if none.
ai/human_assist/getNatureUnitCount: Counts Mother Nature units of a type.
ai/human_assist/getPresetNumber: Returns the active preset, or 0 when villager assist is disabled.
ai/human_assist/getUnit: Returns one unit ID of a type for a player or relation and state; -1 if none.
ai/human_assist/getUnitByLocation: Returns a random unit of a type within a radius of a location; -1 if none.
ai/human_assist/getUnitCountByLocation: Counts units of a type within a radius of a location.
ai/human_assist/getWoodNumber: Returns the requested number of wood gatherers in the split.
ai/human_assist/internalAppendValidResou: Appends valid resources of a type/subtype near a base (wider range for town center bases); returns count added.
Appends valid farms near a base and records their occupancy; returns count added.
ai/human_assist/internalBaseKBResourceID: Copies a slice of a resource array into a list of KB resource IDs.
ai/human_assist/internalBaseNumberResour: Sums gatherer slots for a slice of a resource array (farms counted via farm info).
Returns how many resources a base has in an offset-indexed resource array.
ai/human_assist/internalReturnAndDecreme: Returns the current internal priority counter and decrements it.
ai/human_assist/isFarmPlacementEnabled: True if villager assist may place farms.
ai/human_assist/main: Entry point of the human villager assist script: sets up handlers, reserve plan and rules.
ai/human_assist/onAutoPlanCreate: Handler for engine-created gather plans: sets dropsite auto-building and adds Norse ox carts.
ai/human_assist/removeAllBreakdownsFromB: Removes all food/wood/gold resource breakdowns for a base.
ai/human_assist/setDistributionNumbers: Sets the human player's villager split (food/wood/gold counts, total 1..20) used by villager assist.
ai/human_assist/setPresetNumber: Stores the selected villager assist preset (negative values become 0).
ai/human_assist/setUpFishPlans: Creates fishing plans for each water area group.
ai/human_assist/setupDebugCategories: Creates debug output categories for villager assist.
ai/human_assist/thePeachBlossomSpringMon: Manages which units may enter The Peach Blossom Spring (optionally forbidding all).
ai/human_assist/updateVillagerDistributi: Converts the requested food/wood/gold counts into resource percentages.
ai/human_assist/useSimpleNatureUnitQuery: Configures and returns a shared unit query for Mother Nature units.
ai/human_assist/useSimpleUnitQuery: Configures and returns a shared unit query for a type, player/relation, state and optional position/radius.
ai/human_assist/userControlledVillagers: Handler when the player manually tasks villagers: pauses automatic redistribution for a while.
rm/lib/Biome: Bundles a map theme: culture/civ, lighting, terrain sequence, roads, water, forest, cliff, hunt, herdable, fish and embellishment candidates, with helpers to build custom mixes/water/forests/cliffs.
rm/lib/Biome.addHuntCandidate: Adds a huntable proto with type flags and weight, recording its food per unit.
rm/lib/Biome.createCustomCliff: Creates a custom cliff of passable/impassable inside type from the biome's candidates, optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib/Biome.createCustomForest: Creates a custom forest from a random forest candidate (floor terrain or mix, trees, underbrush), optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib/Biome.createCustomMix: Creates a randomized custom terrain mix from the biome's terrain sequence, optionally as its default; returns the mix ID.
rm/lib/Biome.createCustomWater: Creates a custom water type from a random water candidate and beach/shore sequence, optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib/Biome.getDefaultCliff: Returns the biome's default cliff of the given inside type, creating it if missing.
rm/lib/Biome.getDefaultForest: Returns the biome's default forest, creating it if missing.
rm/lib/Biome.getDefaultMix: Returns the biome's default mix, creating it if missing.
rm/lib/Biome.getDefaultWater: Returns the biome's default water, creating it if missing.
rm/lib/Biome.getHuntCandidates: Collects hunt candidates matching flags whose food per unit fits (or comes closest to) a range; returns true if any fit exactly.
rm/lib/Biome.getMinCandidateFood: Returns the smallest food per unit among hunt candidates matching flags.
rm/lib/Biome.getPlantEmbellishments: Returns the biome's plant embellishment protos.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomBird: Returns a random bird proto from the biome.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomCliff: Returns one of the first N custom cliffs of the inside type, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomDoubleHunt: Picks two hunt types whose combined counts best match a target food value; returns a HuntContainer.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomFish: Returns a random fish proto from the biome.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomForest: Returns one of the first N custom forests, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomHerdable: Returns a random herdable proto from the biome.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomHunt: Returns a single or (with doubleChance) double hunt matching a target food value.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomImpassableCliff: Returns one of the first N impassable custom cliffs, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomLighting: Returns a random lighting set name from the biome's candidates (empty string if none).
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomMix: Returns one of the first N custom mixes, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomPassableCliff: Returns one of the first N passable custom cliffs, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomPredator: Returns a random predator proto from the biome.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomSingleHunt: Picks one hunt type and count that best matches a target food value; returns it as a HuntContainer.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomTree: Returns a random tree proto from one (or a random) forest candidate.
rm/lib/Biome.getRandomWater: Returns one of the first N custom waters, creating more as needed.
rm/lib/Biome.getRangeDelta: Returns how far a value lies outside a [lower, upper] range (0 if inside).
rm/lib/Biome.getRockEmbellishments: Returns the biome's rock embellishment protos.
rm/lib/Biome.randomizeFromCandidates: Picks a weighted-random index from a list of hunt candidates.
rm/lib/CliffData: Cliff inside mix/terrain, side terrains, edge/inside decoration candidates and inside passability used when creating custom cliffs.
rm/lib/ConstraintParameters: Holds a constraint ID plus min/max buffer distances for generators that relax constraints.
rm/lib/ConstraintParameters.set: Stores a constraint ID with its min/max buffer distance.
rm/lib/ForestData: Tree and underbrush candidates plus floor terrains used when creating custom forests.
rm/lib/HuntContainer: Holds a set of hunt protos and counts chosen to reach a food value.
rm/lib/HuntContainer.addToObjectDef: Adds every hunt proto/count in the container to an object definition with cluster distances.
rm/lib/HuntData: Describes one hunt candidate: type flags, proto, food per unit and selection weight.
rm/lib/SectorCircle: Circle split into sectors with a covered arc, used to bias loc placement angles.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.containsAngle: True if an angle lies within the arc.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.containsSector: True if a sector index lies within the arc.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getCoveredAngle: Returns the arc's covered angle in radians.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getExpEndSector: Returns the last sector before the arc (end of its expansion range), or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getExpStartSector: Returns the first sector after the arc (start of its expansion range), or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getNextSector: Returns the next sector index, wrapping around.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getNumCoveredSectors: Returns how many sectors the arc covers.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getPrevSector: Returns the previous sector index, wrapping around.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.getSectorForAngle: Returns the sector index containing an angle.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.hasExpansion: True if the arc covers some but not all sectors.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.hasOverlap: True if this arc and another overlap.
rm/lib/SectorCircle.set: Sets the covered arc from start to end angle, split into numSectors sectors.
rm/lib/VectorLine: Polyline in meters that can be walked along by distance (optionally closed), used to place things along lines.
rm/lib/VectorLine.addPoint: Appends a point in meters to the polyline and updates its length.
rm/lib/VectorLine.calculateLineLength: Recomputes the polyline's total length (including the closing segment if joined at the end).
rm/lib/VectorLine.getCurrDir: Returns the direction of the polyline segment at the current follow position.
rm/lib/VectorLine.getCurrentPoint: Returns the current follow position on the polyline.
rm/lib/VectorLine.getLength: Returns the total length of the polyline in meters.
rm/lib/VectorLine.moveForward: Advances the follow position by a distance (wrapping on closed lines); false when the end is reached.
rm/lib/VectorLine.setCurrentPoint: Moves the follow position to a distance along the polyline; false if beyond its length.
rm/lib/VectorLine.startFollow: Starts following the polyline from its first point and advances by a distance; false if empty.
rm/lib/WaterData: Beach and shore terrain sequences plus bottom terrain used when creating custom water.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer: List of int options with weights for weighted random selection.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.addOption: Adds an int option with a weight (negative weights count as 0).
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.empty: True if no options have been added.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.option: Returns the option value at an index (-1 if out of range).
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.removeOptio: Removes the option at an index and returns its value (-1 if out of range).
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.roll: Picks a weighted-random option, optionally removing it; returns -1 (with optional warning) if empty.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.rollAndRemo: Picks a weighted-random option and removes it.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.rollUniform: Picks an option uniformly, ignoring weights; -1 with an error if empty.
rm/lib/WeightedIntRandomizer.weight: Returns the weight at an index (0 if out of range).
rm/lib/add1v1AreaSimLocs: In 1v1, creates fair mirrored loc pairs and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/add1v1ObjectSimLocs: In 1v1, creates fair mirrored loc pairs and binds an object definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/add1v1SimLocs: In 1v1 only, creates mirrored-fair loc pairs for both players on a chosen side; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addAllySectorBiases: Biases a player loc's angle randomizer toward or away from the nearest ally based on bias flags.
rm/lib/addAreaLocsAtOrigin: Creates locs around an origin and binds an area definition to each; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib/addAreaLocsForPlayer: Creates locs around one player's player locs and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addAreaLocsPerPlayer: Creates locs around every player loc and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addCustomAllySectorBiases: Overridable empty hook for map-specific ally-relative angle biases.
rm/lib/addCustomSectorBiases: Overridable empty hook for adding map-specific angle biases to a loc angle randomizer.
rm/lib/addLocsAtOrigin: Creates numLocs locs around an origin within a distance range and bias; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib/addLocsForPlayer: Creates numLocs locs around each of one player's player locs within a distance range; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib/addLocsPerPlayer: Creates locsPerPlayer locs around every player loc in team order within a distance range; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib/addMirroredAreaLocs: On fair setups, creates mirrored per-player locs and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addMirroredLocsPerPlayer: On fair (mirrorable) setups, creates locs for each player mirrored by point or axis from the first player's; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addMirroredObjectLocsPerPlayer: On fair setups, creates mirrored per-player locs and binds an object definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addObjectLocsAtOrigin: Creates locs around an origin and binds an object definition to each; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib/addObjectLocsForPlayer: Creates locs around one player's player locs and binds an object definition to each (optionally player-owned); returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addObjectLocsPerPlayer: Creates locs around every player loc and binds an object definition to each (optionally player-owned); returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addSectorBiasToRandomizer: Adds sector priorities for a SectorCircle and its expanded range to an angle randomizer.
rm/lib/addSectorBiases: Translates bias flags (forward, aggressive, defensive, inside/outside, etc.) into sector priorities on an angle randomizer.
rm/lib/addSimRadiusAreaLocsPerPlayer: Creates same-radius locs for every player and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addSimRadiusLocsPerPlayer: Creates per-player locs that share the same radius randomizer so every player gets similar distances; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/addSimRadiusObjectLocsPerPlayer: Creates same-radius locs for every player and binds an object definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib/applyGeneratedLocs: Applies the generated locs (places bound objects/areas) and builds any loc paths.
rm/lib/applySuddenDeath: Overridable: removes settlements and places player-owned tents near each start for sudden death.
rm/lib/buildAreaDefPerPlayer: Creates one area from an area definition at every player start and builds them (together or one by one).
rm/lib/buildAreaDefUnderLocs: Creates areas from an area definition under every placed loc and builds them; returns the new area IDs (older lib variant returns nothing).
rm/lib/buildAreaDefUnderObjectDef: Creates areas from an area definition under each object created by an object definition, then builds them; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/buildAreaUnderObjectDef: Paints inner/edge terrain areas of a given radius under each object of an object definition and builds them; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/buildConnectionLabel: Returns a "from-to" label string used to name connection paths/areas.
rm/lib/clampLoc: Clamps a map-fraction location's x and z into 0..1 (y set to 0).
rm/lib/computeForwardAnglesByAllEnemies: Overridable empty hook for forward angles based on all enemies.
rm/lib/computeForwardAnglesByNearestEnem: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to point at the nearest enemy player loc.
Overridable empty hook for forward angles based on the nearest enemy team.
rm/lib/computeForwardAnglesByPlayerAngle: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to face back from its player's angle (toward the origin).
rm/lib/computeForwardAnglesByTeamAngles: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to face back from its team's angle.
rm/lib/computeNearestNeighbors: For each player loc, finds the two nearest allied locs and nearest enemy loc with their angles.
rm/lib/computePlayerAngles: Overridable: computes each player's angle around an origin from the center of their player locs.
rm/lib/computePlayerDistances: Computes and stores distances in meters between every pair of player starts.
rm/lib/computeTeamAngles: Overridable: computes each team's angle around an origin from the center of its players' locs.
rm/lib/computeTeamPlayerOrders: Builds the player orders used for placement: by team, inside-out and as placed.
rm/lib/copyWeightedIntRandomizer: Returns an independent copy of a WeightedIntRandomizer.
rm/lib/createAllyConnections: Like createPlayerConnections but only connects allied player locs in team placement order; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/createAreaConnection: Connects two areas with a single path-based connection area; returns its ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/createAreaConnections: Connects a list of areas in sequence, wrapped ring or all-pairs mode, each with given chance; returns created area IDs.
rm/lib/createBiomeAtlanteanGrass: Builds the Atlantean grassland Biome with terrains, roads, water, forests, cliffs and hunt.
rm/lib/createBiomeEgyptianGrass: Builds the Egyptian grassland Biome with randomized terrain sequence, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishments.
rm/lib/createBiomeGreekGrass: Builds the Greek grassland Biome: terrains, roads, resource ground, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishment candidates.
rm/lib/createBiomeHades: Builds the Hades (underworld) Biome, including its lighting choices, terrains, forests, cliffs and wildlife.
rm/lib/createBiomeMarshGrass: Builds the marsh grassland Biome (randomly Greek or Atlantean culture) with wet terrains, water, forests and hunt.
rm/lib/createBiomeNorseGrass: Builds the Norse grassland Biome with randomized terrain sequence, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishments.
rm/lib/createBiomeTundraGrass: Builds the Norse tundra grassland Biome with terrains, roads, water, forests, cliffs and hunt.
rm/lib/createCornerAreas: Creates four areas in the map corners in a shared class; returns the class ID.
rm/lib/createCornerConstraint: Creates the corner areas and returns a constraint that avoids them.
rm/lib/createNormalizedFractions: Returns numFractions random fractions that sum to 1.
rm/lib/createPlayerAreas: Creates per-player areas that split the map between players with a border gap (once); returns the class ID.
rm/lib/createPlayerBaseAreas: Creates round base areas of a given radius around every player start in a shared class (once); returns the class ID.
rm/lib/createPlayerConnection: Builds a path between two player locs and paints a connection area along it; returns the area ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/createPlayerConnections: Connects player locs pairwise (neighbors only unless connectAll), each with given chance; returns created area IDs.
rm/lib/createPlayerCoreAreas: Creates small round core areas at every player start in a shared class (once); returns the class ID.
rm/lib/createPlayerToAreaConnections: Builds a path and connection area from every player loc to a target area; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/createPlayerToLocConnections: Builds a path and connection area from every player loc to a fixed map location; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/createSequentialIntArray: Builds an int array of consecutive values from start, optionally shuffled (all or all but the first).
rm/lib/createSimpleLocAtOrigin: Creates one loc at an origin with avoid distance, forward angle and radius/angle randomizers; returns the loc ID.
rm/lib/createSimplePlayerLoc: Creates one loc owned by a player at the player's location with randomizers, in-area restriction and forward angle; returns its ID.
rm/lib/createSymmetricBoxConstraint: Creates a box constraint inset by xFrac/zFrac from every map edge (zFrac defaults to xFrac).
rm/lib/createSymmetricBoxDistanceConstra: Creates a constraint keeping things a minimum distance from an inset symmetric box.
rm/lib/createTeamAreas: Creates (or finds) one area per team covering its players' region and records the IDs.
rm/lib/createTeamConnection: Builds a path and connection area between two team areas; returns the area ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/createTeamConnections: Connects team areas pairwise (neighbors only unless connectAll), each with given chance; returns area IDs.
rm/lib/createTownCenterConstraint: Creates a constraint that keeps a distance from town centers.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenAddConstraint: Adds a placement constraint every decorative area must satisfy.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenAddOriginConstraint: Adds a constraint applied only to the origin point of each decorative area.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenAddTerrainLayer: Adds an edge terrain layer (terrain type plus min/max distance from edge) to decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenAddTerrainMixLayer: Adds an edge terrain-mix layer (mix plus min/max distance from edge) to decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenGenerateAreas: Creates and builds up to numAreas decorative areas with the configured settings, retrying on failure; returns how many were built and optionally resets settings.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenGetClassID: Returns the class ID used by decorative area generation, optionally clearing it afterwards.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenReset: Resets every decorative area generation setting (terrain, constraints, size, coherence, smoothing, height, blobs, spacing) to defaults.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenResetConstraints: Clears all area and origin constraints for decorative area generation.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenResetTerrain: Clears terrain type and terrain layers configured for decorative area generation.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetAreaTiles: Sets the min/max size in tiles of generated decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetBlobs: Sets blob count and blob distance ranges used to shape decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetClassID: Sets the class ID that decorative area generation assigns to (and avoids between) its areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetCoherence: Sets the min/max shape coherence range for decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetHeight: Sets the height blend mode and min/max height applied to decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetMixType: Sets a terrain mix to paint decorative areas with.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetSelfAvoidDist: Sets how far decorative areas keep from each other (meters).
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetSmoothDistance: Sets the min/max edge smoothing distance for decorative areas.
rm/lib/decoAreaGenSetTerrainType: Sets a single terrain type to paint decorative areas with.
rm/lib/finalizePlayerPlacement: Overridable step after player placement: computes distances, neighbors, team orders, angles, player/team areas, paths and victory setup.
rm/lib/fixLocDistParams: Clamps min distance to >= 0, replaces negative max distance with the half-map diagonal and keeps max >= min (by reference).
rm/lib/forestGenAddConstraint: Adds a placement constraint (with buffer range) that generated forests must respect.
rm/lib/forestGenAddType: Adds a forest type with a selection weight to the forest generator.
rm/lib/forestGenGenerateCheckedPlayerFor: Placeholder that currently does nothing and returns false.
rm/lib/forestGenGenerateForestsForPlayer: Creates numForests forests within a min/max distance from one player's location; returns how many were built.
rm/lib/forestGenGenerateGlobalForests: Creates up to numForests forests anywhere on the map with current settings, retrying on failure; returns the number built.
rm/lib/forestGenGeneratePlayerForests: Creates forests around every player; returns false if any player got fewer than requested.
rm/lib/forestGenGetForestClass: Returns the class ID used by the forest generator.
rm/lib/forestGenGetForestType: Picks a weighted-random forest type from those added; errors and returns cInvalidID if none.
rm/lib/forestGenReset: Resets forest generator types, constraints and all size/shape/density/height/spacing settings to defaults.
rm/lib/forestGenResetTypes: Clears all forest types and weights from the forest generator.
rm/lib/forestGenSetAreaTiles: Sets the min/max forest size in tiles.
rm/lib/forestGenSetCoherence: Sets the min/max shape coherence of generated forests.
rm/lib/forestGenSetForestClass: Sets the class ID assigned to forests made by the forest generator.
rm/lib/forestGenSetHeight: Sets the height blend and min/max height applied to forest areas.
rm/lib/forestGenSetSelfAvoidDist: Sets the distance (and buffer range) forests keep from each other.
rm/lib/forestGenSetSmoothDistance: Sets the min/max edge smoothing distance of generated forests.
rm/lib/forestGenSetTreeDensity: Sets the min/max tree density of generated forests.
rm/lib/forestGenSetUnderbrushDensity: Sets the min/max underbrush density of generated forests.
rm/lib/gameIs1v1: Overridable: true when there are exactly two players on two teams.
rm/lib/gameIsConquest: True if the conquest victory condition is active.
rm/lib/gameIsFair: Overridable: true when there are two teams of equal size (mirrorable setup).
rm/lib/gameIsKotH: True if the King of the Hill victory condition is active.
rm/lib/gameIsRegicide: True if the regicide victory condition is active.
rm/lib/gameIsSuddenDeath: True if the sudden death victory condition is active.
rm/lib/generate: Overridable empty hook where a map script puts its own generation code.
rm/lib/generateLocations: Runs loc generation and, on success, applies it; on failure can force-place anyway; optionally resets the generator; returns success.
rm/lib/getAngleDifference: Returns the smallest absolute difference between two angles (0..π).
rm/lib/getAxisTilesFromCount: Computes an odd map axis length in tiles from player count, tiles per player and map size factor.
rm/lib/getCrossPlayerIndex: On fair setups, returns the index of the player a half-rotation away from p; 0 otherwise.
rm/lib/getFractionAcceptableTilesForCons: Returns the fraction of map tiles that satisfy a constraint.
Returns the fraction of map tiles that satisfy all constraints in a list.
rm/lib/getInAreaIDForPlayer: Returns the team, player or other area a player's locs should stay inside for the given in-area type.
rm/lib/getLocGenString: Formats a loc generation result line with success/failure, exhaustion and time.
rm/lib/getLocOnEdgeAtAngle: Returns the point where a ray from the map center at the given angle hits the map edge.
rm/lib/getLongestPlayerDistanceToLoc: Returns the distance in meters from a location to the farthest player start.
rm/lib/getMapAreaSizeFactor: Overridable: scale factor for map area based on the selected map size (1 + 0.5 per size step).
rm/lib/getMapSizeBonusFactor: Overridable: map size step + 1, used to scale extra resources on bigger maps.
rm/lib/getMaxRestarts: Overridable: number of generation restarts allowed (0 in non-final builds, 2 in 1v1, otherwise 1).
rm/lib/getMaxTeamPlayers: Returns the player count of the largest team (cached).
rm/lib/getNumberAcceptableTilesForConstr: Counts map tiles that satisfy a constraint.
Counts map tiles that satisfy all constraints in a list (all tiles if the list is empty).
rm/lib/getOpposingPlayerIndex: On fair setups, returns the index of the player directly opposite p; 0 otherwise.
rm/lib/getPlayerDistance: Returns the stored distance between two players (warns on invalid IDs).
rm/lib/getRandomAllyBias: Randomly returns the ally-inside or ally-outside bias flag with the given chance.
rm/lib/getRandomBiome: Picks a weighted-random biome ID from the standard set and returns the matching constructed Biome.
rm/lib/getRandomXZAxis: Randomly returns cAxisX (with xChance) or cAxisZ.
rm/lib/getShortestPlayerDistance: Returns the shortest distance recorded between any two players.
rm/lib/getShortestPlayerDistanceToLoc: Returns the distance in meters from a location to the closest player start.
rm/lib/getShuffledTeamArray: Returns a 1-based array of team numbers in shuffled order.
rm/lib/getSmallestPowerOfTwoLargerThan: Returns the smallest power of two that is >= x.
rm/lib/hasAnyWaterTiles: True if any tile on the map has water.
rm/lib/initDefaultConstraints: Creates the library's standard constraints (tower/settlement ranges, map edge, ship ranges, avoidance distances, etc.).
rm/lib/initializeKotHArea: Overridable: in King of the Hill, creates (once) the hill area at a location; returns its ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib/initializeKotHAreaAtLoc: Overridable: in King of the Hill, creates (once) the hill area with a given radius at a location; returns its ID.
rm/lib/isLocMetersValid: True if a location in meters lies inside the map bounds.
rm/lib/isLocTileValid: True if a tile-index location lies inside the map's tile range.
rm/lib/isLocValid: True if a map-fraction location lies inside the map (x and z within 0..1).
rm/lib/largerFractionToMeters: Converts a map fraction to meters along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib/largerMetersToFraction: Converts meters to a map fraction along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib/largerTilesToFraction: Converts tiles to a map fraction along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib/locInit: Initializes default player ordering and forward angles used by loc generation.
rm/lib/main: Map entry point: runs preGenerate, generate and postGenerate in order.
rm/lib/makeAngleBetweenMinusPiAndPi: Normalizes an angle in radians into [-π, π).
rm/lib/makeAngleBetweenZeroAndTwoPi: Normalizes an angle in radians into [0, 2π).
rm/lib/makePlayerCenterExtensionPaths: Defines a path class and builds a path from the map center to the map edge behind each player (IDs by reference).
rm/lib/makePlayerCenterPaths: Defines a path class and builds a path from the map center to each player start (IDs returned by reference).
rm/lib/makePlayerExtensionPaths: Defines a path class and builds a path from each player start outward to the map edge (IDs by reference).
rm/lib/objectDefConstraintsValidForLocs: True if every location satisfies all constraints of an object definition.
rm/lib/placeKotHObjects: Overridable: in King of the Hill, places the plenty vault and guardians (predators or titans by difficulty) at the hill.
rm/lib/placeKotHObjectsAtLoc: Overridable: in King of the Hill, places the plenty vault and predator guardians at a location, optionally creating the area.
rm/lib/placeLocationsInCircle: Returns n map-fraction locations evenly spaced on a circle (or arc for range < 1) around an origin, with radius/angle jitter.
rm/lib/placeLocationsInLine: Returns n map-fraction locations spread along a line between two points, with sideways and spacing jitter.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefAtLocs: Places one object of a definition at each location in a list for the given owner.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefAtObjectDef: Places one instance of an object definition at the location of every object already created by another object definition.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefInAreaPerPlayer: Places count objects of a definition inside each player's area of the given in-area type, owned by the player or nature.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefInCircle: Places n objects of a definition evenly on a circle/arc around an origin with jitter; returns true.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefInCustomAreaPerPlay: Places count objects of a definition inside each player's custom area.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefInLine: Places n objects of a definition along a line between two points with jitter; returns true.
rm/lib/placeObjectDefPerPlayer: Places an object definition at each player's location within a distance range, owned by the player or nature.
rm/lib/placePlayersOnLine: Places players along a line between two map-fraction points with sideways and spacing variance; returns success.
rm/lib/placeStartingStragglers: Places a random number of nature-owned straggler objects (e.g. trees) around each player start; returns the object definition ID.
rm/lib/placeStartingTownCenters: Places a player-owned town center at each player start; returns the object definition ID.
rm/lib/placeTeamOnLine: Places one team's players along a line between two points; returns success.
rm/lib/postGenerate: Overridable hook after generation: sudden death handling, owner path checks, debug grid and success/failure logging.
rm/lib/postPlayerPlacement: Overridable hook run after players are placed: finalizes placement and optionally initializes the default constraints.
rm/lib/preGenerate: Overridable hook before generation: starts the timer, shuffles teams, sets default object buffering and lighting.
rm/lib/resetLocGen: Resets per-player loc settings, pair-binding distance and the engine loc generator.
rm/lib/revealClosestObjectPerPlayer: For each player, reveals the area around the closest object created by a definition.
rm/lib/rmObjectDefPlacePerPlayer: Places count objects of a definition around every player start within a distance range; returns all placed object IDs.
rm/lib/runLocGen: Runs the engine loc generator (applying default strictness), logs the result and marks generation failed for critical failures; returns success.
rm/lib/setLocsAngleVariance: Sets angle variance (relative or absolute) for each loc in a list.
rm/lib/setLocsArea: Creates an area from a definition for each loc, owned like the loc, and binds it to that loc.
rm/lib/setLocsInAreaID: Restricts every loc in a list to stay inside the given area.
rm/lib/setLocsInAreaType: Restricts each player-owned loc to the area matching the in-area type for its owner.
rm/lib/setLocsObject: Creates an object from a definition for each loc, owned like the loc, and binds it to that loc.
rm/lib/setLocsRadiusVariance: Sets radius variance (relative or absolute) for each loc in a list.
rm/lib/setLocsSquarePlacement: Enables or disables square placement for each loc in a list.
rm/lib/setPlayerDistance: Stores the distance between two players (symmetric) and updates the shortest player distance.
rm/lib/shuffleIntArray: Returns a randomly shuffled copy of an int array.
rm/lib/shuffleIntArrayInPlace: Randomly shuffles an int array in place (by reference).
rm/lib/smallerFractionToMeters: Converts a map fraction to meters along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib/smallerMetersToFraction: Converts meters to a map fraction along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib/smallerTilesToFraction: Converts tiles to a map fraction along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib/translateLoc: Moves a map-fraction location by a distance in meters along an angle, optionally on a square instead of a circle; returns the new fraction location.
rm/lib/vectorXZ: Returns a vector with the given x and z and y = 0.
rm/lib2/Biome: Bundles a map theme: culture/civ, lighting, terrain sequence, roads, water, forest, cliff, hunt, herdable, fish and embellishment candidates, with helpers to build custom mixes/water/forests/cliffs.
rm/lib2/Biome.addHuntCandidate: Adds a huntable proto with type flags and weight, recording its food per unit.
rm/lib2/Biome.createCustomCliff: Creates a custom cliff of passable/impassable inside type from the biome's candidates, optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib2/Biome.createCustomForest: Creates a custom forest from a random forest candidate (floor terrain or mix, trees, underbrush), optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib2/Biome.createCustomMix: Creates a randomized custom terrain mix from the biome's terrain sequence, optionally as its default; returns the mix ID.
rm/lib2/Biome.createCustomWater: Creates a custom water type from a random water candidate and beach/shore sequence, optionally as default; returns its ID.
rm/lib2/Biome.getAllowBerries: True if the biome allows berry bushes.
rm/lib2/Biome.getDefaultCliff: Returns the biome's default cliff of the given inside type, creating it if missing.
rm/lib2/Biome.getDefaultForest: Returns the biome's default forest, creating it if missing.
rm/lib2/Biome.getDefaultMix: Returns the biome's default mix, creating it if missing.
rm/lib2/Biome.getDefaultWater: Returns the biome's default water, creating it if missing.
rm/lib2/Biome.getHuntCandidates: Collects hunt candidates matching flags whose food per unit fits (or comes closest to) a range; returns true if any fit exactly.
rm/lib2/Biome.getMinCandidateFood: Returns the smallest food per unit among hunt candidates matching flags.
rm/lib2/Biome.getPlantEmbellishments: Returns the biome's plant embellishment protos.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomBird: Returns a random bird proto from the biome.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomCliff: Returns one of the first N custom cliffs of the inside type, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomDoubleHunt: Picks two hunt types whose combined counts best match a target food value; returns a HuntContainer.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomFish: Returns a random fish proto from the biome.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomForest: Returns one of the first N custom forests, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomHerdable: Returns a random herdable proto from the biome.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomHunt: Returns a single or (with doubleChance) double hunt matching a target food value.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomImpassableCliff: Returns one of the first N impassable custom cliffs, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomLighting: Returns a random lighting set name from the biome's candidates (empty string if none).
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomMix: Returns one of the first N custom mixes, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomPassableCliff: Returns one of the first N passable custom cliffs, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomPredator: Returns a random predator proto from the biome.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomSingleHunt: Picks one hunt type and count that best matches a target food value; returns it as a HuntContainer.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomTree: Returns a random tree proto from one (or a random) forest candidate.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRandomWater: Returns one of the first N custom waters, creating more as needed.
rm/lib2/Biome.getRangeDelta: Returns how far a value lies outside a [lower, upper] range (0 if inside).
rm/lib2/Biome.getRockEmbellishments: Returns the biome's rock embellishment protos.
rm/lib2/Biome.randomizeFromCandidates: Picks a weighted-random index from a list of hunt candidates.
rm/lib2/CliffData: Cliff inside mix/terrain, side terrains, edge/inside decoration candidates and inside passability used when creating custom cliffs.
rm/lib2/ForestData: Tree and underbrush candidates plus floor terrains used when creating custom forests.
rm/lib2/HuntContainer: Holds a set of hunt protos and counts chosen to reach a food value.
rm/lib2/HuntContainer.addToObjectDef: Adds every hunt proto/count in the container to an object definition with cluster distances.
rm/lib2/HuntData: Describes one hunt candidate: type flags, proto, food per unit and selection weight.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle: Circle split into sectors with a covered arc, used to bias loc placement angles.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.containsAngle: True if an angle lies within the arc.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.containsSector: True if a sector index lies within the arc.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getCoveredAngle: Returns the arc's covered angle in radians.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getExpEndSector: Returns the last sector before the arc (end of its expansion range), or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getExpStartSector: Returns the first sector after the arc (start of its expansion range), or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getNextSector: Returns the next sector index, wrapping around.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getNumCoveredSector: Returns how many sectors the arc covers.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getPrevSector: Returns the previous sector index, wrapping around.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.getSectorForAngle: Returns the sector index containing an angle.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.hasExpansion: True if the arc covers some but not all sectors.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.hasOverlap: True if this arc and another overlap.
rm/lib2/SectorCircle.set: Sets the covered arc from start to end angle, split into numSectors sectors.
rm/lib2/VectorLine: Polyline in meters that can be walked along by distance (optionally closed), used to place things along lines.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.addPoint: Appends a point in meters to the polyline and updates its length.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.calculateLineLength: Recomputes the polyline's total length (including the closing segment if joined at the end).
rm/lib2/VectorLine.getCurrDir: Returns the direction of the polyline segment at the current follow position.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.getCurrentPoint: Returns the current follow position on the polyline.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.getLength: Returns the total length of the polyline in meters.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.moveForward: Advances the follow position by a distance (wrapping on closed lines); false when the end is reached.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.setCurrentPoint: Moves the follow position to a distance along the polyline; false if beyond its length.
rm/lib2/VectorLine.startFollow: Starts following the polyline from its first point and advances by a distance; false if empty.
rm/lib2/WaterData: Beach and shore terrain sequences plus bottom terrain used when creating custom water.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer: List of int options with weights for weighted random selection.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.addOption: Adds an int option with a weight (negative weights count as 0).
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.empty: True if no options have been added.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.option: Returns the option value at an index (-1 if out of range).
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.removeOpti: Removes the option at an index and returns its value (-1 if out of range).
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.roll: Picks a weighted-random option, optionally removing it; returns -1 (with optional warning) if empty.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.rollAndRem: Picks a weighted-random option and removes it.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.rollUnifor: Picks an option uniformly, ignoring weights; -1 with an error if empty.
rm/lib2/WeightedIntRandomizer.weight: Returns the weight at an index (0 if out of range).
rm/lib2/addAllySectorBiases: Biases a player loc's angle randomizer toward or away from the nearest ally based on bias flags.
rm/lib2/addAreaLocsAtOrigin: Creates locs around an origin and binds an area definition to each; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addAreaLocsForPlayer: Creates locs around one player's player locs and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addAreaLocsPerPlayer: Creates locs around every player loc and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addCustomAllySectorBiases: Overridable empty hook for map-specific ally-relative angle biases.
rm/lib2/addCustomSectorBiases: Overridable empty hook for adding map-specific angle biases to a loc angle randomizer.
rm/lib2/addLocsAtOrigin: Creates numLocs locs around an origin within a distance range and bias; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addLocsForPlayer: Creates numLocs locs around each of one player's player locs within a distance range; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addLocsPerPlayer: Creates locsPerPlayer locs around every player loc in team order within a distance range; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addMirroredAreaLocsPerPlayerPair: Creates mirrored loc pairs per player pair and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addMirroredLocsPerPlayerPair: Creates locs for paired opposing player locs, mirrored on a chosen side with a pairing method; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addMirroredObjectLocsPerPlayerPa: Creates mirrored loc pairs per player pair and binds an object definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addObjectDefPlayerLocConstraint: Adds a min-distance-from-all-player-locs constraint to an object definition with optional buffer.
rm/lib2/addObjectLocsAtOrigin: Creates locs around an origin and binds an object definition to each; returns the loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addObjectLocsForPlayer: Creates locs around one player's player locs and binds an object definition to each (optionally player-owned); returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addObjectLocsPerPlayer: Creates locs around every player loc and binds an object definition to each (optionally player-owned); returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addObjectPlayerLocConstraint: Adds a min-distance-from-all-player-locs constraint to an object with optional buffer.
rm/lib2/addProtoCostToPlayerRes: Gives a player extra starting resources equal to a proto's food/wood/gold/favor cost.
rm/lib2/addSectorBiasToRandomizer: Adds sector priorities for a SectorCircle and its expanded range to an angle randomizer.
rm/lib2/addSectorBiases: Translates bias flags (forward, aggressive, defensive, inside/outside, etc.) into sector priorities on an angle randomizer.
rm/lib2/addSimAreaLocsPerPlayerPair: Creates similar mirrored loc pairs per player pair and binds an area definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addSimLocsPerPlayerPair: Creates mirrored loc pairs per player pair with the default similar-loc radius/angle variance; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/addSimObjectLocsPerPlayerPair: Creates similar mirrored loc pairs per player pair and binds an object definition to each; returns loc IDs.
rm/lib2/applyGeneratedLocs: Applies the generated locs (places bound objects/areas) and builds any loc paths.
rm/lib2/applySuddenDeath: Overridable: removes settlements and places player-owned tents near each start for sudden death.
rm/lib2/buildAreaDefAtPlayerLocs: Builds areas from a definition near every player loc within an origin distance range; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/buildAreaDefInTeamAreas: Builds areas from a definition inside each team area, optionally scaled by team size; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/buildAreaDefUnderLocs: Creates areas from an area definition under every placed loc and builds them; returns the new area IDs (older lib variant returns nothing).
rm/lib2/buildAreaDefUnderObjectDef: Creates areas from an area definition under each object created by an object definition, then builds them; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/buildAreaDefUnderPlayerLocs: Creates and builds an area from a definition at every player loc; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/buildAreaUnderObjectDef: Paints inner/edge terrain areas of a given radius under each object of an object definition and builds them; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/buildConnectionLabel: Returns a "from-to" label string used to name connection paths/areas.
rm/lib2/clampLoc: Clamps a map-fraction location's x and z into 0..1 (y set to 0).
rm/lib2/computeForwardAngles: Computes all forward-angle variants (by loc, player, team, nearest enemy) and uses the team-based one as default.
rm/lib2/computeForwardAnglesByNearestEne: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to point at the nearest enemy player loc.
rm/lib2/computeForwardAnglesByPlayerAngl: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to face back from its player's angle (toward the origin).
rm/lib2/computeForwardAnglesByPlayerLocA: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to face back from its own angle (toward the origin).
rm/lib2/computeForwardAnglesByTeamAngles: Overridable: sets each player loc's forward angle to face back from its team's angle.
rm/lib2/computeNearestNeighbors: For each player loc, finds the two nearest allied locs and nearest enemy loc with their angles.
rm/lib2/computePlayerAngles: Overridable: computes each player's angle around an origin from the center of their player locs.
rm/lib2/computePlayerLocAngles: Overridable: computes each player loc's angle around an origin.
rm/lib2/computePlayerLocDistances: Computes and stores distances in meters between every pair of player locs.
rm/lib2/computeTeamAngles: Overridable: computes each team's angle around an origin from the center of its players' locs.
rm/lib2/computeTeamOrders: Records the order in which teams were placed around the map.
rm/lib2/computeTeamPlayerLocOrders: Builds player loc orders per team: as placed and inside-out (middle players first).
rm/lib2/computeTeamPlayerOrders: Builds the player orders used for placement: by team, inside-out and as placed.
rm/lib2/copyWeightedIntRandomizer: Returns an independent copy of a WeightedIntRandomizer.
rm/lib2/createAllyConnections: Like createPlayerConnections but only connects allied player locs in team placement order; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createAreaConnection: Connects two areas with a single path-based connection area; returns its ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/createAreaConnections: Connects a list of areas in sequence, wrapped ring or all-pairs mode, each with given chance; returns created area IDs.
rm/lib2/createAreaToLocConnections: Builds a path and connection area from each listed area to a location; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createBiomeAtlanteanGrass: Builds the Atlantean grassland Biome with terrains, roads, water, forests, cliffs and hunt.
rm/lib2/createBiomeEgyptianGrass: Builds the Egyptian grassland Biome with randomized terrain sequence, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishments.
rm/lib2/createBiomeEgyptianSand: Builds the Egyptian desert sand Biome.
rm/lib2/createBiomeGreekGrass: Builds the Greek grassland Biome: terrains, roads, resource ground, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishment candidates.
rm/lib2/createBiomeGreekGrassSnow: Builds the snowy Greek grassland Biome.
rm/lib2/createBiomeHades: Builds the Hades (underworld) Biome, including its lighting choices, terrains, forests, cliffs and wildlife.
rm/lib2/createBiomeJapaneseGrassSnow: Builds the snowy Japanese grassland Biome.
rm/lib2/createBiomeMarshGrass: Builds the marsh grassland Biome (randomly Greek or Atlantean culture) with wet terrains, water, forests and hunt.
rm/lib2/createBiomeNorseGrass: Builds the Norse grassland Biome with randomized terrain sequence, water, forests, cliffs, hunt and embellishments.
rm/lib2/createBiomeNorseGrassSnow: Builds the snowy Norse grassland Biome.
rm/lib2/createBiomeTundraGrass: Builds the Norse tundra grassland Biome with terrains, roads, water, forests, cliffs and hunt.
rm/lib2/createBiomeTundraGrassSnow: Builds the snowy tundra grassland Biome.
rm/lib2/createCornerDistanceConstraint: Creates a constraint keeping a distance from all four map corners.
rm/lib2/createCornerMaxDistanceConstrain: Creates a constraint keeping within a distance of any map corner.
rm/lib2/createLocConnection: Connects two map locations with one path-based area; returns its ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/createLocConnections: Connects a list of map locations in sequence, ring or all-pairs mode with path-based areas, each with given chance; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createNormalizedFractions: Returns numFractions random fractions that sum to 1.
rm/lib2/createObjectDefOwnerFullPaths: Creates full-length owner paths to every object of an object definition.
rm/lib2/createObjectDefOwnerPaths: Creates owner paths to every object created by an object definition.
rm/lib2/createObjectDefOwnerShortPaths: Creates short owner paths to every object of an object definition.
rm/lib2/createObjectOwnerFullPath: Creates a full-length owner path to an object.
rm/lib2/createObjectOwnerPath: Creates an owner path from the object's owner start to the object.
rm/lib2/createObjectOwnerShortPath: Creates a short owner path (default length) to an object.
rm/lib2/createObjectToLocConnections: Builds a path and connection area from each listed object to a location; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createOwnerPath: Creates a path from a player's start to an owned entity so the route stays clear (optionally only part of the way).
rm/lib2/createPlayerConnection: Builds a path between two player locs and paints a connection area along it; returns the area ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/createPlayerConnections: Connects player locs pairwise (neighbors only unless connectAll), each with given chance; returns created area IDs.
rm/lib2/createPlayerLocAreas: Creates (or finds) one area per player loc dividing the map and records their IDs.
rm/lib2/createPlayerLocDistanceConstrain: Returns (creating once) a constraint keeping a minimum distance from all player locs.
rm/lib2/createPlayerLocMaxDistanceConstr: Returns (creating once) a constraint keeping within a max distance of any player loc.
rm/lib2/createPlayerToAreaConnections: Builds a path and connection area from every player loc to a target area; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createPlayerToLocConnections: Builds a path and connection area from every player loc to a fixed map location; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createSequentialIntArray: Builds an int array of consecutive values from start, optionally shuffled (all or all but the first).
rm/lib2/createSimpleLocAtOrigin: Creates one loc at an origin with avoid distance, forward angle and radius/angle randomizers; returns the loc ID.
rm/lib2/createSimpleLocAtPlayerLoc: Creates one loc owned like a player loc at its position with randomizers, in-area restriction and forward angle; returns its ID.
rm/lib2/createSymmetricBoxConstraint: Creates a box constraint inset by xFrac/zFrac from every map edge (zFrac defaults to xFrac).
rm/lib2/createSymmetricBoxDistanceConstr: Creates a constraint keeping things a minimum distance from an inset symmetric box.
rm/lib2/createSymmetricBoxMaxDistanceCon: Creates a constraint keeping things within a max distance of an inset symmetric box.
rm/lib2/createTeamAreas: Creates (or finds) one area per team covering its players' region and records the IDs.
rm/lib2/createTeamConnection: Builds a path and connection area between two team areas; returns the area ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/createTeamConnections: Connects team areas pairwise (neighbors only unless connectAll), each with given chance; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/createTownCenterConstraint: Creates a constraint that keeps a distance from town centers.
rm/lib2/finalizePlayerPlacement: Overridable step after player placement: computes distances, neighbors, team orders, angles, player/team areas, paths and victory setup.
rm/lib2/findNextAreaName: Returns the first "template N" area name (from startIndex) not used yet.
rm/lib2/fixLocDistParams: Clamps min distance to >= 0, replaces negative max distance with the half-map diagonal and keeps max >= min (by reference).
rm/lib2/gameIs1v1: Overridable: true when there are exactly two players on two teams.
rm/lib2/gameIsConquest: True if the conquest victory condition is active.
rm/lib2/gameIsFair: Overridable: true when there are two teams of equal size (mirrorable setup).
rm/lib2/gameIsKotH: True if the King of the Hill victory condition is active.
rm/lib2/gameIsRegicide: True if the regicide victory condition is active.
rm/lib2/gameIsSandbox: Overridable: true when there is a single player or a single team.
rm/lib2/gameIsSuddenDeath: True if the sudden death victory condition is active.
rm/lib2/generate: Overridable empty hook where a map script puts its own generation code.
rm/lib2/generateLocGenPaths: After loc placement, creates short owner paths for every object bound to a generated loc.
rm/lib2/generateLocs: Runs loc generation and, on success, applies it; on failure can force-place anyway; optionally resets the generator; returns success.
rm/lib2/getAngleDifference: Returns the smallest absolute difference between two angles (0..π).
rm/lib2/getAxisTilesFromPlayerTiles: Computes the map axis length in tiles from player count, tiles per player and map size factor, optionally forced odd.
rm/lib2/getCrossPlayerLocIndex: Returns the player loc index a half-rotation away from the given one.
rm/lib2/getFractionAcceptableTilesForCon: Returns the fraction of map tiles that satisfy a constraint.
Returns the fraction of map tiles that satisfy all constraints in a list.
rm/lib2/getInAreaForPlayerLoc: Overridable: returns the area a player loc's generated locs should stay inside for an in-area type.
rm/lib2/getLocGenString: Formats a loc generation result line with success/failure, exhaustion and time.
rm/lib2/getLocOnEdgeAtAngle: Returns the point where a ray from the map center at the given angle hits the map edge.
rm/lib2/getLongestPlayerLocDistanceToLoc: Returns the distance in meters from a location to the farthest player loc.
rm/lib2/getMapAreaSizeFactor: Overridable: scale factor for map area based on the selected map size (1 + 0.5 per size step).
rm/lib2/getMapSizeBonusFactor: Overridable: map size step + 1, used to scale extra resources on bigger maps.
rm/lib2/getMaxRestarts: Overridable: number of generation restarts allowed (0 in non-final builds, 2 in 1v1, otherwise 1).
rm/lib2/getMaxTeamPlayers: Returns the player count of the largest team (cached).
rm/lib2/getNumberAcceptableTilesForConst: Counts map tiles that satisfy a constraint.
Counts map tiles that satisfy all constraints in a list (all tiles if the list is empty).
rm/lib2/getNumberPlayerLocsForTeam: Counts player locs owned by players of a team.
rm/lib2/getOpposingPlayerLocIndex: Returns the player loc index directly opposite the given one.
rm/lib2/getPlayerLocAreaName: Returns the standard area name for a player loc (owner and owner index).
rm/lib2/getPlayerLocDistance: Returns the stored distance between two player locs (0 for the same loc).
rm/lib2/getPlayerLocDistanceIndex: Returns the index into the triangular player-loc distance table for a pair of loc IDs.
rm/lib2/getPlayerLocIDsForPlayer: Returns the IDs of all player locs owned by a player.
rm/lib2/getPlayerLocIDsForTeam: Returns the IDs of all player locs owned by players of a team.
rm/lib2/getRandomAllyBias: Randomly returns the ally-inside or ally-outside bias flag with the given chance.
rm/lib2/getRandomBiome: Picks a weighted-random biome ID from the standard set and returns the matching constructed Biome.
rm/lib2/getRandomVectorXZ: Returns a vector with random x and z in [minVal, maxVal] and y = 0.
rm/lib2/getRandomXZAxis: Randomly returns cAxisX (with xChance) or cAxisZ.
rm/lib2/getScaledAxisTiles: Scales a 1v1 axis tile size to the current player count and map size.
rm/lib2/getShortestPlayerLocDistance: Returns the shortest distance recorded between any two player locs.
rm/lib2/getShortestPlayerLocDistanceToLo: Returns the distance in meters from a location to the closest player loc.
rm/lib2/getSmallestPowerOfTwoLargerThan: Returns the smallest power of two that is >= x.
rm/lib2/getTeamAreaName: Returns the standard area name for a team.
rm/lib2/hasAnyWaterTiles: True if any tile on the map has water.
rm/lib2/initOwnerBlocker: Creates the path classes and avoidance constraints used to keep paths to owned objects clear.
rm/lib2/initializeDefaultConstraints: Creates the library's standard constraints (corner, avoid-all, edge, water, impassable, building and resource avoidance, etc.).
rm/lib2/initializeKotHArea: Overridable: in King of the Hill, creates (once) the hill area at a location; returns its ID or cInvalidID.
rm/lib2/initializeVictoryConditions: Overridable: creates the King of the Hill class and its avoidance constraint.
rm/lib2/isLocMetersValid: True if a location in meters lies inside the map bounds.
rm/lib2/isLocTileValid: True if a tile-index location lies inside the map's tile range.
rm/lib2/isLocValid: True if a map-fraction location lies inside the map (x and z within 0..1).
rm/lib2/largerFractionToMeters: Converts a map fraction to meters along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib2/largerMetersToFraction: Converts meters to a map fraction along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib2/largerTilesToFraction: Converts tiles to a map fraction along the map's longer axis.
rm/lib2/locPerPlayerCheck: Overridable: true if a player loc should receive per-player locs under the current per-player type (all/inner/outer...).
rm/lib2/main: Map entry point: runs preGenerate, generate and postGenerate in order.
rm/lib2/makeAngleBetweenMinusPiAndPi: Normalizes an angle in radians into [-π, π).
rm/lib2/makeAngleBetweenZeroAndTwoPi: Normalizes an angle in radians into [0, 2π).
rm/lib2/makePlayerLocCenterPaths: Creates (once) paths from the map center to every player loc in a shared class; returns the class ID.
rm/lib2/makePlayerLocEdgePaths: Creates (once) paths from every player loc outward to the map edge in a shared class; returns the class ID.
rm/lib2/objectDefCreateTracked: Creates an object definition and registers it for owner path checks after generation; returns its ID.
rm/lib2/objectOwnerPathCheck: Checks that a player can path from their start to an owned object and logs a warning if not.
rm/lib2/paintTileGridTexture: Overridable debug helper that paints a checker terrain over the whole map (optionally skipping impassable land).
rm/lib2/placeAreaDefUnderLocs: Creates (without building) an area from a definition at every generated loc, with optional size range; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/placeAreaDefUnderObjectDef: Creates (without building) an area from a definition under each object of an object definition; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/placeAreaDefUnderPlayerLocs: Creates (without building) an area from a definition at every player loc, with optional size range; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/placeAreaUnderObjectDef: Creates (without building) inner/edge terrain areas of a radius under each object of an object definition; returns area IDs.
rm/lib2/placeKotHObjects: Overridable: in King of the Hill, places the plenty vault and guardians (predators or titans by difficulty) at the hill.
rm/lib2/placeLocationsInCircle: Returns n map-fraction locations evenly spaced on a circle (or arc for range < 1) around an origin, with radius/angle jitter.
rm/lib2/placeLocationsInLine: Returns n map-fraction locations spread along a line between two points, with sideways and spacing jitter.
rm/lib2/placeObjectDefAtLocs: Places one object of a definition at each location in a list for the given owner.
rm/lib2/placeObjectDefAtObjectDef: Places one instance of an object definition at the location of every object already created by another object definition.
rm/lib2/placeObjectDefAtPlayerLocs: Places one object of a definition at every player loc (player-owned or nature); returns the object IDs.
rm/lib2/placeObjectDefInCircle: Places n objects of a definition evenly on a circle/arc around an origin with jitter; returns true.
rm/lib2/placeObjectDefInLine: Places n objects of a definition along a line between two points with jitter; returns true.
rm/lib2/placePlayersOnLine: Places players along a line between two map-fraction points with sideways and spacing variance; returns success.
rm/lib2/placeStartingStragglers: Places a random number of nature-owned straggler objects (e.g. trees) around each player start; returns the object definition ID.
rm/lib2/placeStartingTownCenters: Places a player-owned town center at each player start; returns the object definition ID.
rm/lib2/placeTeamOnLine: Places one team's players along a line between two points; returns success.
rm/lib2/postGenerate: Overridable hook after generation: sudden death handling, owner path checks, debug grid and success/failure logging.
rm/lib2/postPlayerPlacement: Overridable hook run after players are placed: finalizes placement and optionally initializes the default constraints.
rm/lib2/preGenerate: Overridable hook before generation: starts the timer, shuffles teams, sets default object buffering and lighting.
rm/lib2/resetLocGen: Resets per-player loc settings, pair-binding distance and the engine loc generator.
rm/lib2/resetLocPairBindingDistance: Clears the paired-loc binding distance range.
rm/lib2/resetLocsPerPlayerType: Resets per-player loc selection to all player locs.
rm/lib2/revealClosestObjectPerPlayer: For each player, reveals the area around the closest object created by a definition.
rm/lib2/rotateLoc: Rotates a location around a center point by an angle in the XZ plane.
rm/lib2/runLocGen: Runs the engine loc generator (applying default strictness), logs the result and marks generation failed for critical failures; returns success.
rm/lib2/runOwnerPathChecks: Runs owner path checks for every object created by tracked object definitions.
rm/lib2/setLocPairBindingDistance: Sets the max distance used when binding paired locs of different players.
rm/lib2/setLocPairBindingDistanceRange: Sets the min/max distance used when binding paired locs of different players.
rm/lib2/setLocsAngleVariance: Sets angle variance (relative or absolute) for each loc in a list.
rm/lib2/setLocsArea: Creates an area from a definition for each loc, owned like the loc, and binds it to that loc.
rm/lib2/setLocsInAreaID: Restricts every loc in a list to stay inside the given area.
rm/lib2/setLocsInAreaType: Restricts each player-owned loc to the area matching the in-area type for its owner.
rm/lib2/setLocsObject: Creates an object from a definition for each loc, owned like the loc, and binds it to that loc.
rm/lib2/setLocsPerPlayerType: Chooses which player locs per-player loc generation uses (all, inner, outer, etc.).
rm/lib2/setLocsRadiusVariance: Sets radius variance (relative or absolute) for each loc in a list.
rm/lib2/setLocsSquarePlacement: Enables or disables square placement for each loc in a list.
rm/lib2/setPlayerLocDistance: Stores the distance between two player locs and updates the shortest player-loc distance.
rm/lib2/shuffleIntArray: Returns a randomly shuffled copy of an int array.
rm/lib2/shuffleIntArrayInPlace: Randomly shuffles an int array in place (by reference).
rm/lib2/smallerFractionToMeters: Converts a map fraction to meters along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib2/smallerMetersToFraction: Converts meters to a map fraction along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib2/smallerTilesToFraction: Converts tiles to a map fraction along the map's shorter axis.
rm/lib2/translateLoc: Moves a map-fraction location by a distance in meters along an angle, optionally on a square instead of a circle; returns the new fraction location.
rm/lib2/vectorXZ: Returns a vector with the given x and z and y = 0.
